name: touchdesigner
description: Drives the touchdesigner-mcp server from Claude Code: bundles and preconfigures the server, adds launch/setup/debug/snapshot/overview/perf as slash commands, teaches the node-path and Python-lookup conventions its tools expect, and reminds Claude to verify every network mutation

touchdesigner_host.title: TouchDesigner host
touchdesigner_host.description: Scheme and hostname of the TouchDesigner WebServer DAT, e.g. http://127.0.0.1 — no port, path, or trailing slash. The server appends the port from the TouchDesigner port option.

touchdesigner_port.title: TouchDesigner port
touchdesigner_port.description: Port of the TouchDesigner WebServer DAT
